rows.capability: resource-leases: named exclusive leases with bounded wait
rows.writes: <git-common-dir>/forge/leases/<name>.lock (held during the command); exit 75 on busy
rows.reads: git common dir; holder pid liveness; .forge/config.json leases.waitMs
rows.uiConsumer: CLI stderr waiting/busy notices; forge lease list
rows.evidence: lease.test.mjs, lease-cli.test.mjs, lease-reentrant.test.mjs; e2e resource-leases step

rows.capability: resource-leases: deny-only guard hook for unwrapped matching commands
rows.runtimeOwner: templates/project/{claude,cursor}/hooks/forge-lease-guard.mjs (PreToolUse Bash|PowerShell / preToolUse Shell), wired by forge init
rows.writes: host deny decision only (never allow / updatedInput)
rows.uiConsumer: agent-visible deny reason with the forge lease rerun instruction
rows.evidence: lease-config.test.mjs, lease-guard-hook.test.mjs, init-lease-guard.test.mjs; e2e resource-leases step

rows.capability: test-runs: tier3 and matching configured leases around forge evidence
rows.writes: leases/<name>.lock and leases/tier3.lock during the run; verify-runs stamp only when leases were obtained
rows.uiConsumer: CLI stderr waiting notice naming the holder

rows.capability: worktree-slots: stable per-worktree slot and env
rows.runtimeOwner: forge slot / forge slot env (slot-cli.mjs); forge new; forge reminder (SessionStart hook)
rows.uiConsumer: project tooling loading .forge/slot.env; forge slot env output
rows.evidence: slots.test.mjs, slot-cli.test.mjs, slot-env-file.test.mjs; e2e resource-leases step

rows.capability: project-wiring: doctor reports whether hooks can resolve forge
